verdict.rationale: The axis applies: collecting user feedback tied to error events is a fair question for an error-monitoring platform. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a crash-report dialog, feedback widget, or user-feedback API linked to a specific error event. Session Replay, agent conversation replay and sentry-cli send-event are different features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can collect user feedback — a crash-report dialog or feedback widget — attached to the exact error event the user hit
